description.narrative: Guangxi Fenglin Wood Industry Group Co., Ltd. (Fenglin or the Company) is a leading wood panel manufacturer in China and an existing IFC client. The proposed investment will support Fenglins construction of a greenfield particle board plant in Qinzhou, Guangxi province, a frontier and less developed region of China, with a total capacity of 500,000 m3 wood panel per annum (the Project).

Project level: i) Consumers: The new type of particle board to be produced Super Strong Particle Board (SSPB) will be significantly stronger than regular particle board, which means it will require less fiber and have a wider range of use. Fenglin will be one of the first domestic companies that can produce SSPB and is closely involved in the formulation of industry standards. Consumers will benefit from having better, more durable furniture with smaller environmental footprint. The particle board that Fenglin produces will also meet the strictest international standards for toxic formaldehyde emission, which the consumers will also benefit from. ii) Suppliers: The Project will source majority of its raw materials from the immediate region where most of the suppliers are local farmer households and MSMEs. The Project will procure around 40% more wood than the current level.
Market-level Competitiveness: Fenglin has been an innovative market player and leader in the industry in adopting new production standards. The Project will continue to have an impact on shaping the market in terms of competitiveness through innovation. The SSPB technology upgrades particle board strength to the level of plywood and fine wood boards, which broadens the use of particle board from traditional furniture into interior decoration/furnishing, increasing the sectors resource efficiency and utilization.
